questions.q: How did Sophia Amoruso first build her business?
a: Selling thrift vintage clothes she loved
Opening a restaurant with friends
Licensing a school study program
Running a marketing consultancy
questions.why: The overview says she became an entrepreneur selling thrifted vintage clothes.

questions.q: What did Amoruso do about formal education before succeeding?
a: She dropped out of high school for homeschooling
She earned a business degree first
She trained at a top marketing academy
She completed an MBA at night

questions.q: What can odd jobs and unconventional experiences do for you, according to lesson 1?
a: Teach you about your strengths and open new doors
Prove that a career needs a straight path
Show you that passion is overrated
Guarantee a quick promotion
questions.why: Lesson 1 argues that off-path opportunities build skills and self-knowledge.

questions.q: Once you are doing what you like, how should you treat your business?
a: Know it inside out and ignore what others think
Copy what the largest competitors do
Hand most decisions to outside advisers
Keep changing direction to stay flexible
questions.why: Lesson 2 says to know your business thoroughly and stay focused despite opinions.

questions.q: What does lesson 3 recommend for making a company flourish?
a: Build a community of like-minded people
Hire only people with famous résumés
Work alone to protect your vision
Cut costs by avoiding any team culture
questions.why: Lesson 3 is about creating a community and an environment that suits you.
